title: Rotate secrets, fix .gitignore, add pre-commit hook
description:
P0: API key (DLxQJGounPrxit_ITQlcHBBbXLAbaryl-oduvmQMphw) and GitHub OAuth ClientSecret (9d0b9498af3f872b7cb1289b175498da2ffccdb8) committed in 3 locations: `.vscode/mcp.json`, `artifacts/MemorySmith.App/appsettings.LocalOverrides.json`, and tracked source copy. Root cause: `MemorySmithConfigurationPaths.ResolveSettingsOverridePath` treats `artifacts/MemorySmith.App/appsettings.LocalOverrides.json` as a first-class config discovery candidate — the settings UI writes live secrets there with no `.gitignore` coverage.

Scope:
- Add `artifacts/` (or `artifacts/**/appsettings.LocalOverrides.json`) to `.gitignore`
- `git rm --cached` the tracked copies
- Purge from git history with `git filter-repo`
- Add pre-commit hook (extend existing `.githooks/pre-commit`) to grep for `X-Api-Key`/`ClientSecret` patterns
- Verify with `git ls-files | Select-String "ApiKey|ClientSecret"` returns only placeholder values

Council note: Skeptical Reviewer notes these may be dev values (sitting next to `C:\Users\norrt\` local path). Treat repo-cleanup as urgent; emergency rotation only if production activity confirmed.

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-20260702.md §1.1, audit_review_handoff_7-5-26.md, memorysmith-deep-audit-20260703.md §2

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 6-seat council audit synthesis. Design question: are these values production-live or dev-only? Untested. Treat repo-cleanup as urgent regardless.
